text: Update: PR #5417 (#5405, path-predicate consolidation) is CLEAN/mergeable, Windows CI still running (run 33358679992). PR #5416 (#5401, stop() exception-safety) needed a 3rd round: found the test-only fault-injection hook had no macro gate (unlike every other test-only hook in this codebase), so cf_security shipping it into every production executable -- fixed with a new COPPERFIN_ENABLE_WORKSPACE_AGENT_SESSION_TEST_HOOKS macro matching the existing cf_runtime_pipeline/copperfin_runtime_host convention, verified via nm against a -DCOPPERFIN_BUILD_TESTS=OFF build that the symbol is now genuinely absent (commit aef30814f, Windows CI run 33360425529 running). PR #5418 (new, #5408): consolidated the ScopedFd/ScopedHandle RAII wrappers duplicated across physical_path_containment.cpp/audit_stream.cpp/private_directory.cpp into one canonical copperfin::platform pair -- round-1 adversarial review caught a real windows.h include-order bug (scoped_resource.h included windows.h unguarded before any consumer's own NOMINMAX/WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN guard, silently defeating audit_stream.cpp's NOMINMAX protection for its several unparenthesized std::min/max calls, a bug class this codebase has hit before) -- fixed by having the shared header define both macros itself before its own first windows.h inclusion (commit 42bacfbf9, Windows CI run 33360146658 running). All three PRs' branches are on separate files with no overlap so remain parallel-mergeable. Will merge each once its exact-head Windows CI is green.
